description: Known server-side parameter rules for OpenAI-compatible chat APIs. Used by `drift-check probe --offline`. Add your own with --rules.

rules.message: Reasoning models reject 'max_tokens' (HTTP 400 unsupported_parameter). Use 'max_completion_tokens' instead.
Reasoning models may only accept the default temperature (1). Other values can be rejected by the server.
Reasoning models may only accept the default top_p (1). Other values can be rejected by the server.
